label: Phase noise and its slope
subgoals: Define phase noise in dBc per hertz at an offset
Scale by 20 dB per decade in the one over f squared region
Recognize the flicker and floor regions

label: Multiplication by N
subgoals: Add twenty log ten N to the reference phase noise
Subtract the same amount when dividing

label: From phase noise to jitter
subgoals: Integrate the phase noise over offset, doubling for both sidebands
Take the square root for RMS phase
Divide by two pi f0 to get RMS jitter
